tools.name: search_vehicles
tools.description:
Search the VIP Cars used-car inventory (verified ex-fleet cars, prices in EUR).

Values for the enum-like filters come from the live inventory (e.g. fuel_type
'dizel'/'benzin', body_type 'limuzina'/'suv'/'karavan', transmission 'manualni'/
'automatski', color 'crna'/'siva' — Croatian, as stored). po

tools.name: get_vehicle
tools.description:
Full public details of one vehicle: specs, equipment, condition, description,
photo URLs and the listing_url. Raises an error if the vehicle is not available.

tools.name: compare_vehicles
tools.description:
Compare 2-5 vehicles side by side on key specs (year, mileage, fuel, transmission,
power, price...). Unknown/unavailable ids are listed in 'not_found'.

tools.name: send_inquiry
tools.description:
Send a purchase inquiry (lead) to the VIP Cars sales team on the customer's behalf.
The team calls/e-mails the customer back to arrange a viewing or test drive — there is
no online payment. ALWAYS ask the customer for consent before sharing their contact
details. vehicle_id is optional (omit for a g

tools.name: get_inquiry_status
tools.description:
Check the processing status of an inquiry previously sent with send_inquiry, using
the status_token from its response. The token is issued ONLY to the inquiry's creator —
possession proves ownership; there is nothing to guess or enumerate. Returns ONLY the
processing status, never any customer data.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_vehicle · Private data: send_inquiry, get_inquiry_status · Public sink: send_inquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_vehicle · Private data: send_inquiry, get_inquiry_status · Public sink: send_inquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
